title: Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton Seen Together
summary: Reality television personality Kim Kardashian and Formula 1 driver Lewis Hamilton were seen together on a date night. Kardashian's mother, Kris Jenner, was also present. Reports indicate they shared a public kiss.
